title: Gemma Translator: a two-way voice translator on a Raspberry Pi 5
description:
Gemma Translator is a two-way voice translator that runs entirely on a Raspberry Pi 5 with no internet after setup. Two lanes face each other on a small kiosk screen, each with a rotating language selector: hold a key, speak, and the other side hears it back in their language. Moonshine handles the speech in and out, Gemma does the translation, and the repo ships STL files for the case. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/google-gemma/gemma-translator
